Gurinder Chadha
Gurinder Chadha,( born 10 January 1960) is an English film director of Indian origin. Most of her films explore the lives of Indians living in England. The common theme among her work showcases the trials of Indian women living in England and how they must reconcile their converging traditional and modern cultures. Although many of her films seem like simple quirky comedies about Indian women, they actually address many social and emotional issues, especially ones faced by immigrants caught between two worlds. Much of her work also consists of adaptations from book to film, but with a different flair. She is best known for the hit films" Bhaji on the Beach"( 1993)," Bend It Like Beckham"( 2002)," Bride and Prejudice"( 2004)," Angus, Thongs and Perfect Snogging"( 2008)," It's a Wonderful Afterlife"( 2010) and" Viceroy's House"( 2017). Her latest features are the biographical musical comedy- drama" Blinded by the Light" and the television show" Beecham House".
